subject: FOI/2026/09 and subsequent correspondence – thank you and one remaining point
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear NLW FOI / Enquiries team,

Thank you for the internal-review outcome and the searches of the Bute Estate series (including D153 and D205).

Please confirm whether any further Bute Estate or related classmarks have been identified since the July 2026 searches that relate to Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr / Llandough, the 1877 agreement, the 1916 tenancy, or the 1938–39 sale.

Yours sincerely,
Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant), Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
